tasks.title: Weekend visit
tasks.instruction: You must answer this question. Write your answer in about 100 words.

promptBlocks.text: Read this email from your English-speaking friend, Sam, and the notes you have made.

promptBlocks.subject: Weekend visit!
paragraphs: I'm so excited about visiting you next weekend! My train arrives at 10:30 on Saturday morning. Is that okay?
There are so many things we could do. I'd love to try something local and fun. What do you think?
Also, I'm not sure what food you like. Should I bring anything special for us to eat?
Let me know if I need to bring anything else for the weekend.

promptBlocks.heading: Notes for Sam's email
listItems: Say yes, and suggest a time to meet at the station.
Suggest an activity – say why you think it's a good idea.
Tell him what food you like.
Ask him to bring something you need.

promptBlocks.text: Write your email to Sam using all the notes.

tasks.title: Useful places for teenagers
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write your answer in about 100 words.

promptBlocks.heading: Articles wanted!
paragraphs: What places in your local area are really useful for teenagers?
Describe one place that you think is helpful. What can teenagers do there? Why is it useful?
Write an article answering these questions and we will put it on our website!

tasks.title: The bus that left without me
tasks.instruction: Answer one of these questions. Write your answer in about 100 words.

promptBlocks.text: Your English teacher has asked you to write a story.

promptBlocks.label: Your story must begin with this sentence:
promptBlocks.text: As I watched the bus disappear around the corner, I realised I was completely alone at the bus stop.
